title: ID0389137-DC/Si-D/FI-[kXnNip] Unable to charge from DC1
description:
Location:
Helsinki Vuosaari
Reported behaviour/issue:
Unable to charge from DC1,  always stuck at “Establishing connection” screen then return to the charge point screen with “connected” stated in the outlet. Other outlets worked fine. KF13 changed and issue persisted. Noticed onsite on Friday (8.11.2024 at around 14.22 Finnish time GMT +2)
Root cause: Power Converter PowerOn=False bug
Solution: Install Tia hotfix 3.4.56
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:Siemens
Warranty Status:
Action:
If needed we can plan a site visit for investigation (charger only 30 minutes from office)
